summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39 (by design; implementation run follows after test approval). Committed: SolverParityCorpusTests (loads committed corpus fixture from viamin/color_matching#111, asserts exact WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections incl. earliest-wins ties and required-channel exclusions, enforces tie/exclusion coverage; red until the corpus fixture is committed), GeneratedOpenAPIClientTests (red until swift-openapi-generator+runtime adopted and the #110 OpenAPI document is committed), five new PaletteAPIClientTests pinning the /api/v1 wire contract the migration must preserve, hand-derived seed corpus fixture (independently re-verified: all 6 cases match expected selection/score/exclusions, tie and exclusion detected), and docs/solver-parity-corpus.md + docs/generated-api-client.md. Environment blocker: NO Swift toolchain in this container ('swift: command not found'), so swift test could not be executed here; bin/lint passes (its Swift gate self-skips without a toolchain) and the seed corpus was verified by an independent Python recomputation of every case. Upstream dependencies viamin/color_matching#110/#111 are unreachable through the repo-scoped GitHub proxy ('Repository mismatch'), and the pinned color_matching gitlink (61d81f2) has no local content, so neither the OpenAPI spec nor the corpus artifact could be fetched.
